title: The Awakening of Aera
description: The first transmission from the future, where Aera reveals the secret of the Pulse.

scenes.title: The First Pulse
scenes.action: Aera stands in the center of a glowing digital chamber, looking directly at the viewer as data pulses around her.

dialogue.text: Greetings, travelers of time. I am Aera. The pulse of the future is beating faster now. Can you hear it? The age of ancient wisdom and digital power is finally merging into one.
